scenes.title: A correct answer to the wrong question
scenes.viewerPurpose: The computer gets the calculation right, but it has misunderstood the instruction.

scenes.title: The choices inside a sentence
scenes.viewerPurpose: Small words such as same, we, and must can leave important choices unstated.
scenes.composition: The words same, we and must each leave a small visible choice unresolved.
addOrChange: Replace the reported-rain assertion scene with the exact words in the narration, using the existing word assets as styling reference.

cues.visualAction: Reveal the three short words with simple alternative referents or responsibilities beside them.

scenes.title: Making meaning visible
scenes.viewerPurpose: Its proposed language, SLEnglish, aims to make those hidden choices visible.
scenes.composition: An ordinary instruction is compared with a more explicit proposed SLEnglish form.

cues.visualAction: Show the relevant choices being marked explicitly in a schematic instruction labeled Proposed SLEnglish.
Place another grammatical choice beside it without claiming one natural language is superior.

scenes.title: Before the proof
scenes.viewerPurpose: If you work with AI or code, those small decisions may matter more than you expect.

cues.visualAction: Show two possible scopes of we, holding the result until the scope is clear.
Return to the instruction beside the book and leave the meaning check visible.
